prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished 16:9 desktop pixel-art narrative rhythm debate game screenshot, a real high fidelity art direction proposal, not a web dashboard, not wireframe. It depicts an eighteenth century New York public square debate, Hamilton versus a loyalist merchant, NOT the later cabinet meeting, no Jefferson or Washington. Use the two reference sprite sheets solely for character identity and detailed pixel art style: Hamilton dark swept-back tied brown hair short beard blue coat cream waistcoat, loyalist clean shaven brown swept hair red coat paper notes. Only one of each character in the composition, no sprite sheet, no green backing. Retain crafted pixel clusters, painterly pixel shading, expressive hands, realistic adult proportions for foreground main pixel portraits; small chibi pixel audience in space. Existing game's warm gold, midnight blue, burgundy visual language. All ornament and icons must be fully illustrated pixel textures in brass, carved wood, paper, cloth, never plain rounded web cards. Minimal UI: four visually distinct small response emblems with quill, scales, lightning, raised hands; a short series of golden beat pips; one slim crowd-support display. Keep generous clean dark negative space in the bottom 23 percent for future editable dialogue and response labels. NO readable words, letters, numbers, song lyrics, captions, logos, or watermarks anywhere; text will be supplied by the bilingual game renderer. Upper 75 percent must feel alive with concrete pixel environment and characters; do not obscure it with panels. This is concept art for a camera-focused debate within the existing 3D story, not a new 2D side-scrolling game. CONCEPT A, IMMERSIVE SQUARE: three-quarter perspective with depth through cobblestone square at blue-hour, lanterns, timber colonial houses, a diverse semicircle of small pixel townspeople, barrels, broadsheets. Hamilton left foreground waist-up facing right and speaking assertively, red loyalist right midground facing left listening. Warm moving-stage-like light on Hamilton, cool shadow over opponent, a few papers flying on accent. Crowd physically leans toward speaker. Dramatic intimate HD pixel diorama rather than distant overhead map. Handcrafted unobtrusive lower wooden ledge with parchment subtitle area and four emblem controls. Image fills edge to edge.
